reviews.before: Total post-test (max 27 = 9 MCQ + 18 open-ended). Unprompted/free AI (free-form querying of the RAG assistant, no structured prompts) vs slide-only control: 15.73 vs 15.35 (+0.38 points), d=0.093 -- essentially no effect. Open-ended 10.45 vs 9.68 (d~0.27); MCQ 5.27 vs 5.67 (d~-0.19). SE(d)=0.246 back-calculated from Table 3 means/SDs/Ns; paper reports only omnibus one-way ANOVA (total F=6.82, p=0.0017), not pairwise tests. Contrast n=66 (33 unprompted + 33 control); n_total=95 is the full analytic sample across all three arms. AI used only during the review phase; the post-test itself is unassisted. Free AI use was no better than slide-only review.
